scope: Make DRW_ArcAlignedText DWG encoding transactional across body, string, and handle streams, and verify allocation-failure rollback with same-object retry.

changes: Route the common entity header, ten D2T/text strings, geometry/scalar fields, followed-arc reference, and entity handle through encodeEntityDwgTransaction.
Preserve the existing version-dependent followed-arc handle placement and string fallback behavior.
implementation.failureBehavior: Injected allocation failure preserves all caller stream bytes and bit positions and restores oType; retrying the same entity with the same buffers must exactly match clean output.

validation.allocationSweep: PASS: 2,486 allocation offsets across HATCH, MPOLYGON, MLEADER, and ARCALIGNEDTEXT; 6 common writer versions plus 3 MLEADER versions; 105 entity/version/stream-layout profiles

coverage: The generated ARCALIGNEDTEXT includes distinct text, font, D2T values and a followed-arc handle.
Writer versions AC1015, AC1018, AC1021, AC1024, AC1027, and AC1032 are exercised with five stream alias layouts per version.
Every observed allocation failure checks rollback and exact same-object/same-buffer retry output.
limitations: Generated transaction evidence does not qualify ARCALIGNEDTEXT field semantics, source-producer breadth, graph closure, or native rendering; the external support exclusions remain in force.
No DWG or DXF drawing fixture was added.
